cdes.name: Central Index Key (CIK)
cdes.definition: SEC-assigned unique numeric identifier for every entity that files with the SEC. Used as the primary company identifier throughout the pipeline.

mappings.rationale: Direct mapping from SEC EDGAR API .cik field. Integer type, not zero-padded (API URL uses padded form, table stores integer).

cdes.name: SEC Accession Number
cdes.definition: Unique identifier for each filing submitted to SEC EDGAR. Format: XXXXXXXXXX-YY-ZZZZZZ. Used to trace any data point back to its source filing.

mappings.rationale: Direct mapping from SEC EDGAR API .accn field. Each fact observation references the specific filing it came from.

cdes.name: Legal Entity Name
cdes.definition: Official company name as registered with the SEC. May differ from commonly used brand names (e.g., 'MICROSOFT CORPORATION' vs 'Microsoft Corp.').

mappings.rationale: Direct mapping from SEC EDGAR API .entityName field. Stored as-received in raw zone — name normalization is a Base zone concern.

cdes.name: SEC Filing Date
cdes.definition: Date the filing was officially submitted to and accepted by the SEC. Critical for determining the timeline of financial disclosures and for amendment tracking.

mappings.rationale: Direct mapping from SEC EDGAR API .filed field. Used downstream for amendment detection (later filed_date with same concept+period = potential amendment).

cdes.name: Canonical Entity Name
cdes.definition: Normalized, human-readable company name resolved from raw SEC EDGAR entity names. The authoritative display name for downstream consumers. Produced by entity resolution in the Base zone.

mappings.rationale: Resolved from raw entity_name via KNOWN_ENTITIES exact CIK match (confidence 1.0) or fuzzy name normalization (confidence 0.5). Human-approved before becoming authoritative.

cdes.name: Entity Mapping ID
cdes.definition: Stable identifier for an entity resolution mapping (format: ER-NNN). Used as the primary key for entity_mappings and foreign key in entity_resolution_audit.

mappings.rationale: Sequential ID assigned during entity resolution. Stable across re-runs for the same CIK set. Referenced by audit trail entries.

cdes.name: Total Assets
cdes.definition: Sum of all current and non-current assets reported on the balance sheet.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from us-gaap:Assets via exact match. Appears in 20/20 companies, 2,919 facts.

cdes.name: Total Liabilities
cdes.definition: Sum of all current and non-current liabilities reported on the balance sheet.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from us-gaap:Liabilities and LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity. Multiple XBRL tags normalize to this CDE.

cdes.name: Total Stockholders Equity
cdes.definition: Total equity attributable to shareholders, including common stock, APIC, retained earnings, and AOCI.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from us-gaap:StockholdersEquity and StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest.

cdes.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
cdes.definition: Cash on hand and short-term, highly liquid investments readily convertible to known cash amounts.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue (20 companies) and CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents.

cdes.name: Accounts Receivable
cdes.definition: Amounts owed to the company by customers for goods or services delivered, net of allowances.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from AccountsReceivableNetCurrent (15 companies) plus prefix matches for AccountsReceivable* variants.

cdes.name: Inventory
cdes.definition: Goods available for sale or in production, including raw materials, WIP, and finished goods.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from InventoryNet (14 companies) plus prefix matches for Inventory* variants.

cdes.name: Property Plant and Equipment
cdes.definition: Tangible long-lived assets used in operations, net of accumulated depreciation.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet (19 companies) plus prefix matches.

cdes.name: Goodwill
cdes.definition: Excess of purchase price over fair value of net identifiable assets acquired in a business combination.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from us-gaap:Goodwill (18 companies) plus GoodwillAcquired*, GoodwillImpairment* prefix matches.

cdes.name: Revenue
cdes.definition: Total revenue recognized from the sale of goods and services, before deductions.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from Revenues (17 co), RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax (14 co), SalesRevenueNet (8 co), SalesRevenueGoodsNet (8 co). All revenue variants normalize to one CDE.

cdes.name: Cost of Revenue
cdes.definition: Direct costs attributable to the production of goods and services sold.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from CostOfRevenue, CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold, CostOfGoodsSold — three common variants.

cdes.name: Gross Profit
cdes.definition: Revenue minus cost of revenue. Measures production efficiency.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from us-gaap:GrossProfit. 9 companies report this directly.

cdes.name: Operating Income
cdes.definition: Profit from core business operations, after operating expenses but before interest and taxes.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from OperatingIncomeLoss. 16 companies, 3,447 facts.

cdes.name: Net Income
cdes.definition: Total profit after all expenses, interest, and taxes. Bottom line.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from NetIncomeLoss. All 20 companies, 5,344 facts — most reported concept.

cdes.name: Income Tax Expense
cdes.definition: Total income tax expense (benefit) recognized for the period.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit. All 20 companies, 4,354 facts.

cdes.name: Research and Development Expense
cdes.definition: Costs incurred for research and development activities.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense (11 companies) plus prefix matches for ResearchAndDevelopment* variants.

cdes.name: Selling General and Administrative Expense
cdes.definition: Operating expenses for selling, general, and administrative activities.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense (10 co) and GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense (8 co).

cdes.name: Operating Cash Flow
cdes.definition: Net cash provided by or used in operating activities.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities. All 20 companies, 2,929 facts.

cdes.name: Investing Cash Flow
cdes.definition: Net cash provided by or used in investing activities.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActivities. 20 companies, 2,926 facts.

cdes.name: Financing Cash Flow
cdes.definition: Net cash provided by or used in financing activities.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActivities. All 20 companies, 2,929 facts.

cdes.name: Capital Expenditures
cdes.definition: Payments to acquire property, plant, and equipment.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment (18 companies, 2,738 facts).

cdes.name: Earnings Per Share Basic
cdes.definition: Net income divided by weighted average basic shares outstanding.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from EarningsPerShareBasic (19 companies, 4,504 facts) plus EarningsPerShare* prefix matches.

cdes.name: Earnings Per Share Diluted
cdes.definition: Net income divided by weighted average diluted shares outstanding.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from EarningsPerShareDiluted (18 companies, 4,588 facts).

cdes.name: Dividends Per Share
cdes.definition: Cash dividends declared per common share.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared (15 co) and CommonStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid (11 co).

cdes.name: Comprehensive Income
cdes.definition: Net income plus other comprehensive income items (unrealized gains/losses, foreign currency adjustments).

mappings.rationale: Mapped from ComprehensiveIncomeNetOfTax (20 co) and OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTax (19 co) plus prefix matches.

cdes.name: Retained Earnings
cdes.definition: Cumulative net income retained in the business, not distributed as dividends.

mappings.rationale: Mapped from RetainedEarningsAccumulatedDeficit (20 co, 2,729 facts) plus prefix matches.
